facts.fact: African Manager reports that the ARP Rights and Freedoms Committee reviewed the draft opinion on the proposed organic law on personal data protection, a 123-article text in 6 titles, and began examining the articles of the first title (no event date given beyond the article date, 2026-02-20).
facts.system: Proposed organic law on personal data protection (123 articles)

facts.fact: The committee began article-by-article examination of the 123-article bill, which its sponsors say responds to the limited role of the existing authority and adds rules on AI, surveillance cameras and health data.
facts.system: Proposed organic law on personal data protection (123 articles)
